precondition: Experiment-wide PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE.json exists and lists the candidate. B0 must not be read otherwise.
training_policy: After candidate selection is fully frozen on W17 TRAIN and W18 DEV, deterministic parametric models may be refit on W17+W18 using exactly the frozen features, transforms, target, and hyperparameters. No candidate, feature, threshold, interaction, normalization rule, outcome, or subset may change after B0 is opened.

005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.fit: OLS on W17+W18 exact-economics rows; frozen state baseline plus either log absolute episode size or log episode-size/touch-depth
005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.b0_pass: relative-size B0 R2 > absolute-size B0 R2 and relative-size B0 R2 > 0

005H-C02-FAILED-REPLENISHMENT.b0_pass: failed-minus-recovered aggressor-signed 30s continuation gap > 0 and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound > 0

005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.fit: same frozen without-replacement same-token matched-control algorithm
005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.b0_pass: at least 50 B0 pairs and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound of fill-minus-control aggressor-signed 30s move > 0

005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.fit: frozen ridge logistic model refit on W17+W18 matched case/control rows
005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.b0_pass: B0 AUC >= 0.60, both classes present, and each chronological half AUC >= 0.55

005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.fit: frozen ridge logistic model refit on W17+W18 linked fills
005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.b0_pass: B0 AUC >= 0.58, at least 100 BUY and 100 SELL rows, and each chronological half AUC >= 0.52

005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.fit: frozen OLS state baseline versus the exact shortlisted OFI-or-microprice challenger, refit on W17+W18
005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.b0_pass: challenger B0 R2 exceeds baseline by at least 0.005 and the improvement remains positive under frozen stale-book and high-activity exclusions

multiple_testing_policy: Each candidate is an already frozen mechanism family from DEV; B0 is one-shot confirmation, not a new search. Report all evaluated candidates, including failures. No replacement candidates are allowed.
post_b0_policy: No retuning, rescue subsets, threshold changes, new interactions, feature additions, or repeated B0 execution for scientific selection.
deployment_boundary: A B0 pass is historical same-source confirmation only. It never directly authorizes MAKE or real SIG orders and remains FUTURE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.
